convention: World blocks. x east, z south, y up. Room box x0..x1, z0..z1 are the wall lines; the inside is x0+1..x1-1. Local coords: lx = wx-(x0+0.5), lz = wz-(z0+0.5), so lx runs 0..w where w=x1-x0. doors/windows: [wall, a0, a1] in local blocks along that wall (N and S walls run along x; W and E along z). holes: stairwells, voids, steps and the 2 kept clear round them, local [lx0,lz0,lx1,lz1] by cell. ceil: clear height in blocks. depot: the Depot v20 room type it was planned as.
